title: Concept: One-time passcode served in a response
description: An OTP in a response defeats the purpose of the second factor: whatever reaches the client can be copied before the customer types it, and the copy stays valid for the whole validity window.
applicability: Login step-up, transaction confirmation, password reset and mobile-app API responses.
risk: An attacker who can observe the response (shared device, proxy, cached API payload, malicious extension) completes the second factor without the customer's phone.
